The '''Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill''' was an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] and leisure hall located on [[StarForge Station]], a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]]. In existence by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill was the place where the ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] crew of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' finalized their [[Letter of marque/Legends|letter of marque and reprisal]] for serving as [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutinying]] against the Galactic Empire.

==Description==
The Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill was an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] and leisure hall that was located in the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] known as [[StarForge Station]], which was in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]]. The Lean Nuuti was dark, grubby, and dank. It possessed a beat-up [[autojuke]] for playing [[Music/Legends|music]] and had a game of [[holodarts]], as well as several tables that were looked after by a [[Service droid/Legends|serving droid]]. Among the items the Lean Nuuti served were [[flangth]], [[ootoowerg]]s, and [[Shasa ale]]. The grill commonly catered to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and the other [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] individuals who frequented StarForge Station.<ref name="Orbit" />

==History==
{{Quote|So they are letting humans in here now? I will have to eat other places. The bad smell makes me sick.|One of the thugs insults the ''Far Orbit'' crew members|<ref name="Orbit" />}}
[[File:Lean_Nuuti_fight.jpg|thumb|right|100px|A fight in the Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill]]
In existence by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> the Lean Nuuti was the meeting place where the mutinous crew of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' met with a representative from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the crew [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|seized]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from the Empire. The meeting was intended to finalize the terms of the [[Letter of marque/Legends|letter of marque and reprisal]] that would allow the ''Far Orbit'' to serve as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] vessel for the Rebels. Instructed to enter as a party of six and order flangth and ootoowergs alongside Shasa ale, those crew members of the ''Far Orbit'' would then be approached by an [[Unidentified Ithorian (StarForge Station)|Ithorian]]. After the crew ordered, the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] approached them and informed them that there were no ootoowergs left. Under the guise of going with the Ithorian to check what was available, the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]], and [[Unidentified Far Orbit crew member|another crew member]] went to clarify the final deal with the Alliance. While Vedij was gone, four alien thugs came up to the remaining crew members and insulted them.<ref name="Orbit" />

{{RPGseed}}
The insults led to the start of a fight between the two groups. However, when Vedij returned from successfully negotiating with the Alliance, he halted the fight with an order, before taking his crew to find [[Bunk/Legends|bunks]] for the night.<ref name="Orbit" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. The fight in the Lean Nuuti can be won by either side, according to how the players play it, with the losing side buying the other drinks. If the fight ends in a draw, the aliens will buy the crew members drinks to make things even between them.<ref name="Orbit" />
